description: Backup & Restore manager for n8n Docker instances via GitHub

commands.name: welcome
commands.help: Show the welcome / quick-start screen (default when no command is given)

commands.name: backup
examples: n8n-manager backup -c n8n -t ghp_xxx -r user/backups --backup-type workflows
n8n-manager backup -c n8n -t ghp_xxx -r user/backups --backup-layout combined
n8n-manager backup -c n8n -t ghp_xxx -r user/backups --backup-layout workflow-bundles --workflow-id "wf123"
n8n-manager backup -c n8n -t ghp_xxx -r user/backups --backup-type credentials --credential-export-mode encrypted
n8n-manager backup -c n8n -t ghp_xxx -r user/backups --backup-type credentials --credential-export-mode decrypted

commands.name: restore
examples: n8n-manager restore -c n8n -t ghp_xxx -r user/backups --restore-type workflows
n8n-manager restore -c n8n -t ghp_xxx -r user/backups --restore-type enterprise
n8n-manager restore -c n8n -t ghp_xxx -r user/backups --restore-mode new-only

pat_input_methods.description: Read PAT from stdin. PAT never appears in the generated command string, /proc/<pid>/cmdline, or shell history.
Read PAT from a file. File must be chmod 600 — refused otherwise. Recommended for cron / systemd.

pat_input_methods.warning: PAT lands in shell history and `ps -ef`. Acceptable on personal workstations only.

compatibility_constraints.message: --target writes to a separate dir; --branch overrides the sibling-branch name. Pick one.

compatibility_constraints.warning: Plaintext credentials in the output. Use private repos only and only when you understand the secret-handling implications.
Allows plaintext credential export during pre-restore snapshot. Files written umask 077 and shredded on cleanup.
May corrupt data when n8n migrations-table hash diverges from the pinned set.
Skips the v4-shape adapter. Reduced validation. Emergency-restore semantics.
